q: Cocycle superrigidity (Zimmer's theorem, 1980) states that a cocycle α: Γ × X → H over an ergodic action of a higher-rank lattice Γ into a real algebraic group H is:
opts: Cohomologous to a homomorphism Γ → H (up to compact noise)
exp: Zimmer's cocycle superrigidity theorem: any measurable cocycle over an ergodic action of a higher-rank lattice into a real algebraic group is cohomologous to a representation (homomorphism) up to a compact group factor. This is the dynamical analogue of Margulis superrigidity.
